prompts.initial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final production pixel-art walking sprite sheet for a top-down Godot game.
Reference image: identity and pixel-art style reference only. Redraw ONLY the small human huntress at the far left; no monsters. Preserve her purple oversized hood, short purple cape, burgundy scarf, pale face with red eyes, dark brown tunic, belt with small amber gem, brown boots. Simplify detail to match the small monsters. Empty hands, no weapon, no ground shadow.
Create ONE transparent sprite sheet, regular grid of EXACTLY NINE COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, 45 separate sprites. All cells same size, generous transparent separation, no labels or grid lines. Each character around 90 pixels tall with deliberate hard square pixel clusters, dark outlines, limited palette and 2-3 shades per material. All frames same anatomy, costume and head proportions.
ROW 1: walking facing screen RIGHT, true profile.
ROW 2: walking facing DOWN-RIGHT, front three-quarter.
ROW 3: walking facing DOWN, front.
ROW 4: walking facing UP-RIGHT, rear three-quarter.
ROW 5: walking facing UP, rear.
In EACH row COLUMN 1 is a stationary neutral standing pose with both boots resting evenly.
COLUMNS 2 through 9 are EIGHT consecutive frames of ONE COMPLETE walking cycle. Crucial: animate BOTH legs, alternating feet. Never repeat a half-step twice. Column2 contact A: near/anatomical left foot fully FORWARD, opposite foot fully BACK. Column3 recoil A. Column4 passing: rear leg swings under hip. Column5 high passing A. Column6 contact B: OPPOSITE foot fully FORWARD, first foot fully BACK. Column7 recoil B. Column8 passing B. Column9 high passing B leading smoothly back to column2. Contact A and B must show swapped legs, not the same lifted boot again. Broad readable strides, bent swing knee, planted support foot. Two complete opposite steps per eight frames. Subtle two-pixel hip rise/fall and cape follow-through; head stable. At front/back use strong alternating knee lift and boot foreshortening. Keep the cape above knees so both legs are readable.
Consistent sprite height, cell spacing, body anchor and ground baseline through all frames. Genuine alpha transparency; no text, numbers, shadows, UI, scenery, gradients, anti-aliasing or painted rendering. This is a clean newly drawn uniform sheet, not a collage of previous animation art.
prompts.rejected_half_step_correction:
Edit this sprite sheet. Keep EXACT same character, pixel-art style, grid of 9 columns by 5 rows, all head/cape/torso/arms pixels as consistent as possible, genuine transparency.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: the legs in columns 6,7,8,9 are currently repeating the SAME half-step as columns 2,3,4,5. REDRAW ONLY THE LEGS AND BOOTS so each row becomes a real complete two-step walk cycle. Do not merely change how high the SAME foot is.
Give the character's NEAR leg a noticeably LIGHTER brown boot and the FAR leg a DARKER brown boot, consistently throughout each view, so the alternating leg identities are visible.
For right-facing rows (1,2,4):
Column1 stationary neutral.
Column2: LIGHT near leg extended far FORWARD to the RIGHT; DARK far leg planted BEHIND to the LEFT.
Column3: LIGHT near leg planted ahead, DARK far knee bends and advances from behind.
Column4: LIGHT support leg vertical UNDER HIP, DARK swing leg overlapping forward across it, knee visibly bent.
Column5: LIGHT support leg moving backward, DARK leg extending forward.
Column6: DARK far leg is extended FORWARD to the RIGHT, LIGHT near leg stretched BEHIND to the LEFT. This is visibly the OPPOSITE contact stance from column2. The LIGHT boot must now be the LEFTMOST boot in the sprite.
Column7: DARK far support leg planted ahead, LIGHT near knee bending and lifting from the LEFT behind.
Column8: DARK support leg under hip, LIGHT near swing knee raised and crossing toward the front.
Column9: DARK support leg behind to the left, LIGHT near boot swinging forward to the right, returning into column2.
For front row3 and back row5: left boot forward/lower and right boot back/higher in column2; RIGHT boot forward/lower and LEFT boot back/higher in column6, with alternating swing poses.
Both feet must change longitudinal position, not just wiggle in the same spot. Make poses more distinct and readable, two opposite contacts, two opposite passing positions, equal stride size. Preserve the same body size, hood, short cape, burgundy scarf, amber charm and outfit. No shadows, text or backgrounds.
prompts.new_pose_guided_sheet:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Input image 1 is a PRECISE POSE/LAYOUT GUIDE to render, not a style reference. Input image 2 is the character identity and finished pixel-art reference: ONLY the human huntress at far left.
Produce one final transparent pixel-art sprite sheet by dressing every guide skeleton as that SAME hooded huntress. Follow image1 EXACT cell arrangement, foot positions and light-versus-dark leg identity. Do not invent another sequence or rearrange poses. 9 columns x5 rows, neutral column1 +8 sequential walking frames columns2-9. EACH colored leg is a distinct anatomical leg: retain the positions of the light brown and dark brown boots exactly in each cell. The legs exchange forward/back positions between columns2 and6. They cross and pass under the hips in columns4 and8. This guide is specifically to avoid repeating the same half-step twice.
Directions per row: row1 screen-right side profile; row2 down-right front3/4; row3 front down; row4 up-right rear3/4; row5 rear up. Use proper facing heads and torsos for these directions; the guide's round heads only mark their locations. Replace skeletal limbs with organic pixel-art trousers and brown leather boots while preserving knee, ankle, sole positions. Keep legs fully readable; short cape stops at hips. Character identity: deep purple hood and cape, burgundy scarf, pale skin, red eyes, dark brown fitted leather outfit, waist belt and little amber diamond charm. Same simple proportions and two/three shade pixel clusters as the reference monsters, clean dark pixel outline, no smooth painted rendering.
Keep full figure height, head size, waist height, anatomy and costume absolutely consistent. Torso, hands, scarf and short cape have restrained follow-through and opposing arm swing. Empty hands, no sword/gun, no floor, no cast shadow. Remove every line and the light background of the guide; genuine alpha background. No labels, grid, numbers, accessories added, decorative frame or UI. All 45 characters separated by clear transparent gutters.
prompts.final_palette_only_edit:
Edit ONLY the leg colors in this completed 9-column, 5-row pixel-art animation sheet. Preserve EXACTLY every pose, foot position, knee position, face, hood, cape, clothing, frame arrangement and silhouette. Do NOT redraw the gait or change leg shapes.
The bright orange/gold legs were anatomy-guide colors, not part of the outfit. Replace the bright orange on ALL legs with dark brown leather matching the character's belt and original boots. Both legs wear the SAME dark brown trousers and boots. The nearer leg can be one shade lighter than the far leg, but not yellow, orange, glowing, skin-colored or metallic. Use a limited dark brown leather ramp: deep #30242b shadow, #574034 base, #765643 restrained highlight. Retain readable separation of the legs and EXACT alternate forward/back positions throughout each row. No ambient glow around boots.
Also ensure all fully filled character pixels are opaque, hard pixel edges, zero alpha outside sprites, no halo. Preserve genuine transparent background. Empty hands, no scenery, labels, floor or shadows. Absolutely no change to the anatomy or layout.
